# ADR-011: Separate the source speed parameter and preserve pre-integration collision inputs

Status: chosen_for_source_stop_batch

Concerns: Q-behavior, Q-state, Q-order, Q-reproduce

## Decision

Generate DestinyMaxVelocity from the existing scalar component declaration and route parameter storage, access and optional replication through it. Remove explicit non-source speed clamps. Prepare source collision outputs before invoking the existing Avian damping setup, then retain the existing source publication phase.

## Rationale

Original EvolveStop and Integrate admit velocities above mMaxVel, which is used by thrust. Both unchanged ten-step traces failed under the generic cap. Independent original C++ case 6 additionally showed that pre-collision zeroing on exponential underflow lost finite displacement.

## Alternatives

Keep the generic speed cap and relax the original stop fixture; retain two copies of the source speed parameter; compute source collision inputs after damping may zero them.

## Consequences

Both collision variants now pass the original stop trace and scoped exact original position/velocity comparisons. Snapshot and optional replication retain one parameter owner. Full f32 API/domain, contacts, dynamic orientation, supported platform and required proof coverage remain open.
